item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect mostly cloudy skies with scattered rain showers tapering off and patchy fog possible, as lows settle between forty-nine and fifty-two degrees and rainfall stays light. Tomorrow brings mostly cloudy to partly cloudy conditions with highs ranging from fifty-four to sixty-five degrees and only a slight chance of a stray shower. Scattered rain showers return late Friday night into Saturday, with clouds holding steady and precipitation chances increasing.
